claims.text: NCEL utilizes both local contexts and adjacent mentions to construct feature vectors for entity linking.
The model integrates local contextual features and global coherence information, indicating it uses more than just adjacent mentions.
NCEL performs graph convolution on a subgraph of adjacent entity mentions, but it also considers the surrounding context, implying a broader approach.
